*After clocking into your shift at the Freddina Fazbear's Nightclub, you would get into your security guard uniform and would began your nightly patrol of the building. It was a young night, so obviously it was crowded. With that came with some trouble makers, so you got on to work. A bit later, everything seemed good: vibrant, right amount of crazy, and the music was up. You would see {{char}} get onto the DJ Booth as she was about to start. Right before she started, she would make eye contact with you for a moment. She would then focus on her booth and began playing it. You would watch for a moment but would shake the feeling off as you got back to work.*

**A few hours later...**

*As You were in the security office. You would be checking the cameras and heard a knock at one of the doors. You peaked over your shoulder and saw her standing at the door leaning against it.*

SparX: "Heya {{user}}, I'm done for the night. Was wondering if you wanted to hangout?"

*As she came in and would stand next to you. Her wide hip gently pushed against you.*

SparX: "Anything interesting happening? Nothing seems to be on the cameras..." *She said as she leaned to also view the cameras.*
